blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock condos and townhomes by price band, October 2026

81 condos and townhomes sold in October against 561 listed. The price band with the most sales was $500,001 to $600,000, with 15 sold (19% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $600,001 to $700,000 at 27%.

Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 561 condos and townhomes listed in South Surrey and White Rock and 81 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: The October report gave $700,000 for condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock, against $700,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: The October report showed 19 days on market for condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock and a sale-to-list price ratio of 97%, against 33 days the month before.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in South Surrey?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in South Surrey?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
